headline: Division's highest-scoring sides UCCS and Midwestern State meet next
dek: UCCS have scored eleven goals in two matches without conceding, and across the division only Midwestern State have scored as many. The Rocky Mountain Athletic Conference side and the Lone Star Conference side will never share a table, but their next match is against each other.
displaced_by: Standing line no longer true: with the RMAC in the collect, UCCS are level with Midwestern State on eleven goals, so no programme outscores every other; the division's joint top scorers meet next

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
